clue.text: Not rare words of praise

definitions.meaning: meat that is not rare has been cooked right through
a congratulation said to someone who has achieved something

explanation.surface: Someone praising a steak that is not cooked rare.
explanation.definitionFit: A steak cooked thoroughly is the opposite of rare, and the same phrase is a common congratulation.

clue.text: Brave campers might be found in it

definitions.text: Brave campers might be found in it

parts.words: Brave campers might be found in it
parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior, so the tent here is the conical shelter of such people, not a bold holidaymaker's tent

explanation.definitionFit: A domed or conical dwelling of bark or hides used by some Native American peoples.

clue.text: Acid test?

parts.note: the idiom for a decisive trial is taken literally as a chemical test for acidity

explanation.definitionFit: Paper treated with a dye that turns red in acid and blue in alkali.

clue.text: Teamaker inside ring during daylight hours

indicators.note: inside places the teamaker within the ring

parts.note: to dial is to ring someone on the phone, and a dial is a ring of numbers
an urn is a large vessel for making tea

explanation.surface: Someone makes tea inside a ring at daytime.
explanation.definitionFit: Happening in the daytime, as opposed to nocturnal.

clue.text: No good at taking the long view?

definitions.text: No good at taking the long view?

parts.words: No good at taking the long view?
parts.note: the phrase for lacking foresight is taken literally as poor eyesight for distant objects

explanation.definitionFit: Myopic, able to see close things clearly but distant ones blurred.

clue.text: Essential that flat should have push-button controls

parts.note: key means essential, as in a key point
pad is informal for a flat or apartment

explanation.surface: A remark that a flat ought to have push-button gadgets.
explanation.definitionFit: A pad of buttons for entering numbers or commands, as on a phone or alarm.

clue.text: Eject old beans

parts.note: ex- means former or old, as in ex-wife
pulses are the edible seeds of legumes such as beans

explanation.surface: Throwing out stale beans.
explanation.definitionFit: An old form of expel, meaning to drive out.

clue.text: Project by prig about to go off

indicators.note: about means around, so the prig surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a prude is a priggish, easily shocked person
to rot is to go off, as food does

explanation.surface: A self-righteous person's plan about to fail.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick out, as a ledge projects from a wall.

clue.text: Laundress did not start bothering ballerinas' partners

indicators.note: bothering means agitating, so the remaining letters are shaken up
the word laundress loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: A washerwoman pesters the male dancers in a ballet company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'did not start' removes L from LAUNDRESS, leaving AUNDRESS; 'bothering' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Male ballet dancers, who partner ballerinas on stage.

clue.text: Harsh-sounding canal said to be by Albert

indicators.note: said tells us to take a word as it is spoken, not as written

parts.note: a gutter is a channel or canal carrying water
Al is a short form of the name Albert

explanation.surface: A complaint that some canal near a man called Albert sounds harsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canal' is not a waterway here but a roadside channel; the spoken word, not the spelling, goes into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A throaty, rasping voice is described with this word, from the Latin for throat.

clue.text: Put about before being won over in residential area

indicators.note: about means the letters of put are moved around
over here signals that the letters of won are turned over into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone moves house to a neighbourhood after being persuaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges PUT to UPT; 'over' rearranges WON to OWN. 'won over' looks like persuaded.
explanation.definitionFit: In American use, the part of a city away from the centre where people live.

clue.text: A child of five a saint, st. Thomas

parts.note: a quin is one of quintuplets, five children born together

explanation.surface: A list describing a saint who was one of five siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: The thirteenth-century Dominican theologian Saint Thomas from Aquino in Italy.

clue.text: I reveal remarkable lady

indicators.note: remarkable can be read as re-markable, able to be marked out again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone boasts that they will unveil an extraordinary woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so an example of a lady.

clue.text: Said to disguise manner of saying goodbye

indicators.note: said tells us to use the spoken sound of the word that follows

parts.note: to veil something is to disguise or hide it
diction is one's way of speaking and enunciating

explanation.surface: A speaker hides their accent when bidding farewell.
explanation.walkthrough: VEIL spoken sounds like VALE, Latin for farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: A farewell, or the act of bidding farewell, as in a parting speech.

clue.text: Legitimate offer creditor cannot refuse

parts.note: legal means lawful or legitimate
to tender is to offer, and a tender is an offer

explanation.surface: A lawful proposal that a lender is obliged to accept.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a description: money that a creditor cannot refuse in payment of a debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Coins and notes that by law must be accepted when offered to settle a debt.

clue.text: Flying elephant?

parts.note: Jumbo was a famous elephant, so a big airliner can be pictured as an elephant in the air

explanation.definitionFit: A large wide-bodied airliner such as the Boeing 747, named after Jumbo the circus elephant.

clue.text: Notice politician with resistance be included — one speaking off-the-cuff

indicators.note: included means the word be is placed inside the rest

parts.note: ad, an advertisement, is a notice
a Lib is a Liberal politician
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A poster about a politician who resists, and a speaker who improvises.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who improvises speech rather than following a script.

clue.text: To bed unduly troubled — definitely

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone going to sleep anxious, without any doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean certainly, beyond question.

clue.text: Melted going to pieces on furze

indicators.note: going to pieces means falling apart, so the letters break up and regroup

explanation.surface: Something thawing and collapsing onto gorse.
explanation.walkthrough: Furze is gorse, a spiny heathland shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Thawed, no longer frozen solid.

clue.text: Farmworker employed in making up trains!

definitions.meaning: a labourer who works around a farmyard
a railway worker who assembles trains in a marshalling yard

explanation.surface: A farmhand is hired to assemble railway trains.
explanation.definitionFit: A man who works in a yard, whether a farmyard or a railway marshalling yard.

clue.text: Sailor's hat?

parts.note: a flat straw hat suggests a sailor's headgear, and someone who goes boating could be named by the same word

explanation.definitionFit: A stiff flat-topped straw hat, once worn for boating.

clue.text: Some dishy bride of mixed ancestry

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a good-looking bride's family background is mixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Bred from two different kinds or breeds, so of mixed parentage.

clue.text: Shorted

parts.note: read as supplied with shorts, the underpants known as briefs, rather than given too little

explanation.definitionFit: To be given the briefing is to be filled in on a matter, while briefs are short underpants.

clue.text: Superficial nursery rhyme

definitions.meaning: read literally, a word that rhymes with nursery

explanation.surface: A dismissive verdict on a children's verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A hasty, perfunctory glance, and a word that ends with the same sound as the word nursery.

clue.text: Josephine put black mark on collection

parts.note: Jo is a short form of the name Josephine
a blot is a stain or a black mark against one's name

explanation.surface: A woman named Josephine smudges a stain onto her assortment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put ... on' is a positional link: in a down-free across clue, the black mark comes after the woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction term for a mixed lot of items sold together as one group.

clue.text: Team ride dangerously taking transverse measurement

indicators.note: dangerously suggests wild, reckless movement, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A team cycling recklessly while someone measures across something.
explanation.definitionFit: A straight line through the centre of a circle, measuring its width across.

clue.text: Top artist?

definitions.meaning: a spinning top is something that turns round and round
J. M. W. ..., the English landscape painter

explanation.surface: Praise for a leading painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning toy is literally a thing that rotates, and the English painter of seascapes bore this surname.

clue.text: Caught during finale consuming gin

indicators.note: consuming means swallowing, so one word takes the other inside it

parts.note: the end is the finale
a gin is a trap for catching animals, as is a snare

explanation.surface: Someone is caught drinking gin during a show's finale.
explanation.walkthrough: Gin here is not the drink but a trap.
explanation.definitionFit: Trapped, as an animal is in a snare.
